# Validation

```{r model_family_header, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
acousticTS:::.model_family_header(
  family = "hpa",
  pages = c(
    Overview = "index.html",
    Theory = "hpa-theory.html",
    Implementation = "hpa-implementation.html",
    Benchmarks = "hpa-benchmarks.html",
    Validation = "hpa-validation.html"
  )
)
```

HPA is checked against spherical exact/modal references for liquid-filled and gas-filled targets over frequency, orientation, radius, and material contrast.

::: {.tip data-title="Residuals near nulls"}
Mean absolute differences describe the typical agreement; maximum differences are retained because deep nulls can expose localized convention or resolution errors.
:::
